name: Dr Fran Beilharz
title: Lead Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical Psychologist and experienced eating disorder clinician. Committed to providing trauma-informed, neurodiversity affirming, LGBTIQA+ inclusive and gender affirming care; enjoys working with clients who have multiple marginalised identities. AusPATH provider. Uses CBT, CBT-E, TBT-S, ACT and DBT with a weight-inclusive, non-diet approach.
specialties: eating disorders, body dysmorphic disorder, body image, LGBTIQA+ inclusive, gender affirming, trauma-informed, AusPATH
identity: 'Fran is a proud member of the queer community'

name: Felicity Staedler
title: Senior Psychologist
description: Registered Psychologist with over 12 years of experience. Uses CBT, ACT and Schema Therapy according to client needs; person-centred and values driven. Aligned with Health at Every Size principles, helping clients improve their relationships with their bodies, food and exercise.
specialties: schema therapy, eating disorders, ACT, CBT, body image

name: Genevieve Fletcher
title: Provisional Psychologist (Low Cost Clinic)
description: Provisional Psychologist in the Low Cost Provisional Psychology Clinic (no Medicare rebates). Works with adults and adolescents including 'Gender diversity, LGBTQIA+ mental health issues' and 'Relationships, intimacy and communication difficulties', plus eating disorders and body image (excluding anorexia), anxiety, depression and insomnia (CBT-i Level 1).
specialties: gender diversity, LGBTQIA+, intimacy, eating disorders, body image, CBT-i, insomnia, low cost

name: Kellie Dundon
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Uses CBT, CBT-E, ACT and EMDR as appropriate. 'She has a particular interest in providing support to individuals who have lived through traumatic experiences.' Works from a strengths-based and trauma-informed perspective; HAES-aligned, non-diet approach.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, eating disorders, body image, anxiety, CBT-E, ACT

name: Phoebe Beveridge
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Particular interest in the intersection between eating disorders and trauma, and how early relational experiences shape relationships with food, bodies, and ourselves. Works with complex trauma. Draws on Schema Therapy as her primary therapeutic approach, plus CBT-E and ACT; trauma-informed, HAES-aligned.
specialties: schema therapy, complex trauma, eating disorders, CBT-E, ACT

name: Rebecca Brooks
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Committed to providing a safe, trauma-informed, and neuro-affirming space. Works from CBT integrating DBT, Cognitive Processing Therapy and Solution-Focused Therapy, supporting trauma, grief and loss, anxiety disorders, mood disorders, and relationship difficulties.
specialties: trauma, CPT, DBT, CBT, grief, neuro-affirming

name: Stacey Van Der Meer
title: Registered Psychologist / Clinical Registrar
description: Particularly focused on providing neuro-affirming and gender-affirming care. Experienced eating disorder clinician also supporting post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), complex PTSD, mood, anxiety and OCD. Trained in SSCM, CBT-E, Schema Therapy interventions, and Cognitive Processing Therapy for PTSD and C-PTSD.
specialties: gender-affirming, PTSD, complex PTSD, schema therapy, CPT, eating disorders, OCD, neuro-affirming
